docs.title: Layer 1 — MT4Account (low-level)
docs.text: Direct proto/gRPC calls. Build a Request, read a Reply.Data. Full control, highest verbosity. Location: package/Helpers/MT4Account.cs. Docs: this folder (you are here).

docs.title: Layer 2 — MT4Service
docs.text: Thin typed facade over MT4Account: forwards the data methods 1:1 and adds convenience getters (GetBalanceAsync, GetSpreadAsync, GetDigitsAsync, …) that have no single low-level call. It is also the surface the Sugar layer extends. Docs: MT4Service API.

docs.title: Layer 3 — MT4Sugar
docs.text:
High-level convenience on top of MT4Service: snapshots, normalization, risk-based sizing, market orders with SL/TP in points, bulk close, tick/trade streams. Docs: MT4Sugar API.

Rule of thumb: low-level 1:1 wrappers (Quote, AccountSummary, OrderSend) look identical at the Service layer because the Service just forwards them — the Service's value is the getters + Sugar surface.

docs.title: ⚠️ Important notes
docs.text:
• Demo first. Always test on a demo account before going live.
  • Re-query before acting. Equity/floating P/L and open-order lists are snapshots.
  • UTC everywhere. Prefer the *Utc timestamp fields; convert only for display.
  • Streams are open-ended. Always pass a CancellationToken; cancellation completes them gracefully.
  • Broker rules. Respect Digits, VolumeMin/Max/Step and minimum stop distances (see Market Info).

Low-level foundation (MT4Account) → typed facade (MT4Service) → convenience (MT4Sugar).

docs.title: ✅ Getting an Account Summary
docs.text:
Request: full account summary (AccountSummaryData) from MT4. Fetch all core account metrics in a single call.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.AccountSummaryAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: AccountSummary (account-helper proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: AccountSummary(AccountSummaryRequest) → AccountSummaryReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): AccountHelper.AccountHelperClient.AccountSummaryAsync(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<AccountSummaryData> AccountSummaryAsync(
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

AccountSummaryRequest {} (no fields)

Reply message:

AccountSummaryReply { data: AccountSummaryData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
// MT4Service returns the data; you decide how to present it.
var s = await _service.AccountSummaryAsync();
_logger.LogInformation("Balance={Balance}, Equity={Equity}, Currency={Currency}",
    s.AccountBalance, s.AccountEquity, s.AccountCurrency);

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)); // keep short; bump if your terminal is slow
var summary = await _mt4.AccountSummaryAsync(
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

_logger.LogInformation("Account Summary: Balance={Balance}, Equity={Equity}, Currency={Currency}",
    summary.AccountBalance,
    summary.AccountEquity,
    summary.AccountCurrency);

docs.title: 🔽Input
docs.text:
No required input parameters.

Optional:

  • deadline (DateTime?) — optional UTC deadline for request timeout.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken) — token to cancel the operation.

docs.title: ⬆️Output
docs.text:
Returns an AccountSummaryData structure with the following fields:

Field Type Description AccountLogin long Account number (login ID). AccountBalance double Account balance excluding open positions. AccountEquity double Equity — balance including floating P/L. AccountMargin double Currently used margin. AccountMarginFree double Free margin available for opening new trades. AccountMarginLevel double Margin level, percent = (Equity / Margin) × 100. AccountCredit double Credit amount. AccountCurrency string Account deposit currency (e.g. "USD", "EUR"). AccountLeverage long Leverage applied to the account. AccountUserName string Account holder's name. AccountCompanyName string Broker's name or company. AccountTradeMode EnumAccountTradeMode Demo / contest / real — see enum below. AccountMarginMode EnumAccountMarginMode Netting / exchange / hedging — see enum below.

docs.title: EnumAccountTradeMode — field AccountTradeMode
docs.text:
• AccountTradeModeDemo = 0 — demo / practice account
  • AccountTradeModeContest = 1 — contest account
  • AccountTradeModeReal = 2 — real (live) trading account

docs.title: EnumAccountMarginMode — field AccountMarginMode
docs.text:
• AccountMarginModeRetailNetting = 0 — retail, netting (one net position per symbol)
  • AccountMarginModeExchange = 1 — exchange margin model
  • AccountMarginModeRetailHedging = 2 — retail, hedging (the usual MT4 model)

docs.title: 🎯Purpose
docs.text:
This method is used to retrieve real-time account information and is typically used for:

  • Displaying account status in dashboards or UI
  • Validating available margin and balance before trading
  • Monitoring overall account exposure and risk

It's a foundational API call for any MT4 integration dealing with trading or reporting.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Connection required. The call throws a clear error if not connected (guarded by EnsureConnected()). Connect via ConnectByServerNameAsync / ConnectByHostPortAsync first.
  • Timeouts. Example uses a 3s CancellationTokenSource for snappy UX. If you don't pass a deadline, the library's default per-RPC timeout is 8s (DefaultRpcTimeout).
  • Reconnect behavior. Under the hood, unary calls use ExecuteWithReconnect: retries on transient gRPC statuses (Unavailable, DeadlineExceeded, Internal) and on reconnectable terminal errors (TERMINAL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND, TERMINAL_REGISTRY_TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND). Exponential backoff starts \~250ms with jitter (±150ms), capped at 5s, max attempts 8.
  • Snapshot semantics. AccountEquity/AccountBalance are snapshots. Re-query right before risk checks or order placement.
  • Currencies. AccountCurrency is your deposit currency; instrument P/L may be in the quote currency—don't mix them in math without converting.
  • Formatting. Round for display only; keep raw doubles for calculations.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Stale terminal. With a disconnected/paused terminal, values might be outdated without a hard server error. Log connection state alongside numbers.
  • Roll-over effects. Swaps/commissions around roll-over can cause brief equity/balance divergences.
  • Type matching. Use the exact generated C# types from the proto for arithmetic/serialization to avoid subtle overflow/rounding issues.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Values are non-negative; currency is non-empty; equity ≈ balance on a flat account.
  • Edge cases. With open positions, equity != balance and margins/free margins look reasonable.
  • Failure path. Simulate terminal down/unavailable: expect a clear exception (no crash), and bounded retries/backoff visible in logs.

docs.title: Account — Overview
docs.text: This section groups methods for reading account state and performance: a full snapshot, trade statistics, per-order unrealized extrema, and equity history. Use it for dashboards, risk checks and reporting.

docs.title: 📂 Methods in this folder
docs.text:
• AccountSummary.md Complete account snapshot (balance, equity, margin, leverage, currency, trade/margin mode, server time).

  • TradeStats.md Aggregated statistics — open/closed counts, profit by period, drawdowns, per-market breakdown.

  • TradeUnrealizedPL.md Per-open-order unrealized P/L extrema (best/worst floating P/L with timestamps).

  • EquityHistory.md Time series of equity/balance points with running drawdowns — the equity curve.

  • TradeStatsEquityHistory.md Combined stats + equity chart points + the trade list, in one call.

docs.title: ⚡ Example Workflow (service wrapper — data-returning)
docs.text:
// 1) One-glance account state
var s = await _service.AccountSummaryAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{s.AccountLogin} {s.AccountCurrency} Bal={s.AccountBalance} Eq={s.AccountEquity}");

// 2) Headline performance
var stats = (await _service.TradeStatsAsync()).Summary;
Console.WriteLine($"open={stats?.OpenTrades} total={stats?.TotalProfit}");

// 3) Equity curve (summarize — payload can be large)
var eq = await _service.EquityHistoryAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{eq.Points.Count} equity point(s)");

// 4) Everything for a report in one round trip
var sc = await _service.TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{sc.Charts.Count} points, {sc.Trades.Count} trades");

docs.title: ✅ Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Snapshot for liveness. AccountSummaryAsync is the cheapest "is the connection alive?" check — login/currency/equity present → good.
  2. Summarize big reads. EquityHistory and TradeStatsEquityHistory can be large; print counts/last point, and use from / excludeSameBars to trim.
  3. Deadlines & cancellation. Pass deadline/CancellationToken for snappy UX; the library applies sensible defaults with automatic reconnection.
  4. Currency discipline. All money fields are in the account deposit currency — don't mix with instrument quote currency without converting.
  5. Snapshot semantics. Equity, OpenProfit and unrealized extrema are live — re-query right before risk decisions.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
A compact toolkit for account state and performance:

  • Snapshot → Statistics → Equity curve → Full report.
  • Feed dashboards, risk guards and exports.
  • Predictable timeouts, retries and clear error surfaces.

👉 Use this overview as a map and follow links to each .md file for complete method details, parameters, enums (where used) and pitfalls.

docs.title: Getting Equity History
docs.text:
Request: time series of equity points (EquityHistoryData) from MT4 Balance/equity samples over time with running drawdowns and realized/unrealized P/L — the raw material for an equity curve.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.EquityHistoryAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Proto definition: EquityHistory (trade-stats proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Method: EquityHistory(EquityHistoryRequest) → EquityHistoryReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): TradeStats.TradeStatsClient.EquityHistoryAsync(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<EquityHistoryData> EquityHistoryAsync(
            string? from = null,
            bool excludeSameBars = false,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

EquityHistoryRequest { from?: string, excludeSameBars: bool }

Reply message:

EquityHistoryReply { data: EquityHistoryData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var eq = await _service.EquityHistoryAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{eq.Points.Count} equity point(s)");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
var data = await _mt4.EquityHistoryAsync(
    from: null,               // optional ISO start date
    excludeSameBars: false,   // true = collapse consecutive identical points
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

var last = data.Points.LastOrDefault();
Console.WriteLine($"Latest: balance={last?.Balance} equity={last?.Equity} @ {last?.TimeUtc}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from string? Optional ISO start date; null = full history excludeSameBars bool Collapse consecutive identical points to shrink the payload deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — EquityHistoryData
docs.text: Field Type Description Points RepeatedField<EquityPointData> Ordered equity samples.

docs.title: EquityPointData (each point)
docs.text: Field Type Description Time Timestamp Sample time (server local). TimeUtc Timestamp Sample time (UTC). Balance double Balance at this point. Equity double Equity at this point. BalanceDrawdownRaw double Balance drawdown, absolute. BalanceDrawdownRelative double Balance drawdown, relative (%). EquityDrawdownRaw double Equity drawdown, absolute. EquityDrawdownRelative double Equity drawdown, relative (%). RealizedPl double Realized P/L up to this point. UnrealizedPl double Floating P/L at this point. CashFlow double Deposits/withdrawals effect.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Draw and analyze the account equity curve:

  • Equity/balance charts for dashboards and reports.
  • Drawdown analysis straight from the series.
  • Separating realized vs floating contribution over time.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Payload size. Long histories can be large; set excludeSameBars: true or a from date to trim.
  • UTC. Use TimeUtc for storage/joins; Time is for local display.
  • Ordering. Points are time-ordered; Points.Last() is the most recent sample.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Big responses. Printing the whole object floods the console — summarize (count + last point) as above.
  • Sparse data. New accounts yield few points; chart code should handle short series.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Points is non-empty and time-ordered; Equity ≈ Balance on a flat account.
  • Edge cases. excludeSameBars: true reduces the count without changing the shape of the curve.

docs.title: Getting Trade Statistics
docs.text:
Request: aggregated trade statistics (StatsData) from MT4 Open/closed trade counts, profit by period, drawdowns and per-market breakdown — in one call.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.TradeStatsAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Proto definition: TradeStats (trade-stats proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Method: TradeStats(TradeStatsRequest) → TradeStatsReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): TradeStats.TradeStatsClient.TradeStatsAsync(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<StatsData> TradeStatsAsync(
            string? from = null,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

TradeStatsRequest { from?: string }

Reply message:

TradeStatsReply { data: StatsData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var stats = await _service.TradeStatsAsync();
var sum = stats.Summary;
_logger.LogInformation("open={Open} openProfit={OpenPL} total={Total}",
    sum?.OpenTrades, sum?.OpenProfit, sum?.TotalProfit);

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
var s = await _mt4.TradeStatsAsync(
    from: null,          // optional ISO start date, e.g. "2026-01-01"
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

Console.WriteLine($"Open: {s.Summary.OpenTrades}, Total profit: {s.Summary.TotalProfit}, Pips: {s.Pips}, Lots: {s.Lots}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from string? Optional ISO start date (e.g. "2026-01-01"); null = all history deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — StatsData
docs.text: Field Type Description Summary TradeSummaryData Headline counts & profit (see below). MaxBalanceDrawdownRaw double Largest balance drawdown, absolute. MaxBalanceDrawdownRelative double Largest balance drawdown, relative (%). MaxEquityDrawdownRaw double Largest equity drawdown, absolute. MaxEquityDrawdownRelative double Largest equity drawdown, relative (%). Markets RepeatedField<MarketTradeCountData> Per-symbol trade breakdown. Profitability ProfitabilityData Win/loss ratios and related metrics. Pips double Net pips. Lots double Total traded volume (lots). Comissions double Total commissions.

docs.title: TradeSummaryData (the Summary field)
docs.text: Field Type Description OpenTrades int Currently open trades. OpenProfit double Floating profit of open trades. DayProfit double Realized profit today. WeekProfit double Realized profit this week. MonthProfit double Realized profit this month. TotalProfit double Realized profit over the period.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
A compact performance snapshot for dashboards and risk checks:

  • Current exposure (open trades + floating profit).
  • Realized profit by day/week/month/total.
  • Drawdown and per-market breakdown for reporting.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Summary first. For a quick line, read Summary (open/open-profit/total); the rest is for deeper reports.
  • from filter. Pass an ISO date to scope statistics to a period; omit for full history.
  • Snapshot semantics. OpenProfit is floating — re-query right before risk decisions.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Empty history. A fresh account returns zeros, not an error — guard division when computing ratios.
  • Currency. Money fields are in the account deposit currency; don't mix with instrument quote currency.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. On an account with activity, TotalProfit and Lots are populated; Summary.OpenTrades matches OpenedOrders.
  • Edge cases. With from set to today, period profits narrow to today's realized P/L.

docs.title: Getting Stats + Equity Chart + Trades
docs.text:
Request: combined statistics, equity chart points and the trade list (StatsWithChartsData) from MT4 One call that returns the StatsData, the equity curve points, and the closed/open trades behind the numbers.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Proto definition: TradeStatsEquityHistory (trade-stats proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Method: TradeStatsEquityHistory(TradeStatsEquityHistoryRequest) → TradeStatsEquityHistoryReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): TradeStats.TradeStatsClient.TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<StatsWithChartsData> TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync(
            string? from = null,
            bool excludeSameBars = false,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

TradeStatsEquityHistoryRequest { from?: string, excludeSameBars: bool }

Reply message:

TradeStatsEquityHistoryReply { data: StatsWithChartsData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var sc = await _service.TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{sc.Charts.Count} chart point(s), {sc.Trades.Count} trade(s), {sc.OpenTrades.Count} open");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
var data = await _mt4.TradeStatsEquityHistoryAsync(
    from: null,
    excludeSameBars: false,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

Console.WriteLine($"Total profit: {data.Stats.Summary.TotalProfit}, points: {data.Charts.Count}");
foreach (var t in data.Trades)
    Console.WriteLine($"#{t.Ticket} {t.Symbol} {(t.IsBuy ? "BUY" : "SELL")} {t.Lots} P/L={t.Profit}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from string? Optional ISO start date; null = full history excludeSameBars bool Collapse consecutive identical equity points deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — StatsWithChartsData
docs.text: Field Type Description Stats StatsData Same statistics as TradeStats. Charts RepeatedField<EquityPointData> Equity curve points (see EquityHistory). Trades RepeatedField<TradeHistoryItemData> Closed trades behind the stats. OpenTrades RepeatedField<TradeHistoryItemData> Currently open trades.

docs.title: TradeHistoryItemData (each trade)
docs.text: Field Type Description Ticket long Trade ticket. Symbol string Symbol. IsBuy bool Direction (true = buy). Lots double Volume in lots. OpenPrice double Open price. ClosePrice double Close price (0 while open). OpenTime Timestamp Open time (local). CloseTime Timestamp Close time (local; unset if open). Profit double Realized profit. Commission double Commission.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Everything a performance report needs in a single round trip:

  • Equity curve and the trades that produced it — no second call.
  • Combine with Stats.Summary for headline numbers plus detail.
  • Feed analytics / export without stitching separate responses.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Heavy payload. This is the largest account read (stats + chart + trades). Summarize counts before printing, and use from / excludeSameBars to trim.
  • Reuses other shapes. Charts are EquityPointData and Stats is the same StatsData as TradeStatsAsync — document once, reference here.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Console flooding. Never dump the whole object; iterate Trades or print counts.
  • Open vs closed. Trades are closed; currently open ones are in OpenTrades (ClosePrice/CloseTime unset).

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Charts non-empty; Stats.Summary.TotalProfit matches TradeStatsAsync; OpenTrades.Count matches OpenedOrders.
  • Edge cases. excludeSameBars: true shrinks Charts without dropping trades.

docs.title: Getting Unrealized P/L Extrema
docs.text:
Request: per-order unrealized P/L extrema (TradeUnrealizedPLData) from MT4 For each currently open order, the best (max) and worst (min) floating P/L reached, with timestamps.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.TradeUnrealizedPLAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Proto definition: TradeUnrealizedPL (trade-stats proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Method: TradeUnrealizedPL(TradeUnrealizedPLRequest) → TradeUnrealizedPLReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): TradeStats.TradeStatsClient.TradeUnrealizedPLAsync(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<TradeUnrealizedPLData> TradeUnrealizedPLAsync(
            string? from = null,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

TradeUnrealizedPLRequest { from?: string }

Reply message:

TradeUnrealizedPLReply { data: TradeUnrealizedPLData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var upl = await _service.TradeUnrealizedPLAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{upl.Extrema.Count} open order(s) tracked");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
var data = await _mt4.TradeUnrealizedPLAsync(
    from: null,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var e in data.Extrema)
    Console.WriteLine($"#{e.Ticket} {e.Symbol}: max={e.MaxUnrealizedPl} min={e.MinUnrealizedPl}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from string? Optional ISO start date; null = all open orders deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — TradeUnrealizedPLData
docs.text: Field Type Description Extrema RepeatedField<TradeUnrealizedExtremaData> One entry per open order.

docs.title: TradeUnrealizedExtremaData (each item)
docs.text: Field Type Description Ticket long Order ticket. Symbol string Symbol of the order. MaxUnrealizedPl double Best floating P/L reached. MaxUnrealizedTime Timestamp Server time of the max (local). MaxUnrealizedTimeUtc Timestamp Server time of the max (UTC). MinUnrealizedPl double Worst floating P/L reached. MinUnrealizedTime Timestamp Server time of the min (local). MinUnrealizedTimeUtc Timestamp Server time of the min (UTC).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Understand how far each open order swung in your favor and against you:

  • Post-trade analysis of maximum adverse/favorable excursion (MAE/MFE).
  • Tuning stop-loss / take-profit distances from real swings.
  • Spotting orders that gave back large unrealized gains.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Open orders only. Extrema are tracked for currently open orders; closed orders live in history (OrdersHistory).
  • Timestamps. Prefer the *Utc fields for storage/comparison; convert local only for display.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Empty result. With no open orders, Extrema is empty — not an error.
  • Fresh orders. A just-opened order may show max ≈ min until the market moves.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Extrema.Count equals the number of open orders; each MaxUnrealizedPl >= MinUnrealizedPl.
  • Edge cases. Flat account → empty list; handle without dividing by zero in analytics.

docs.title: Getting All Available Symbols
docs.text:
Request: retrieve a list of all symbols (instruments) available in the terminal Returns all symbol names and their corresponding internal indices.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.SymbolsAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: Symbols (in the MarketInfo service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: Symbols(SymbolsRequest) → SymbolsReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): MarketInfo.MarketInfoClient.Symbols(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<SymbolsData> SymbolsAsync(
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

SymbolsRequest {}

Reply message:

SymbolsReply { data: SymbolsData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var all = await _service.SymbolsAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"{all.SymbolNameInfos.Count} instruments");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)); // keep short; bump if your terminal is slow
var symbols = await _mt4.SymbolsAsync(
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var entry in symbols.SymbolNameInfos)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Symbol: {entry.SymbolName}, Index: {entry.SymbolIndex}");
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
No required parameters.

Optional:

  • deadline (DateTime?) — optional UTC deadline for request timeout.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken) — token to cancel the operation.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns a SymbolsData object containing:

Field Type Description SymbolNameInfos IList<SymbolNameInfo> All available symbols with their MT4 indices

Each SymbolNameInfo includes:

Field Type Description SymbolName string Trading symbol name (e.g. EURUSD) SymbolIndex int Internal symbol index

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Enumerate all instruments available to the logged-in account. Useful for:

  • Populating UI dropdowns or symbol selectors
  • Building watchlists
  • Running batch requests over multiple symbols

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Broker suffixes. Some brokers append suffixes to symbol names (e.g., EURUSD.r, XAUUSD.m). Use exactly the names returned here when requesting quotes or placing orders.
  • Account scope. The list may vary by account type/permissions. Cache the result per session to avoid repeated calls.

docs.title: Getting OHLC Bars
docs.text:
Request: historical OHLC bars (QuoteHistoryBarsData) for a symbol/timeframe over a UTC range. Similar to QuoteHistory, but returns the broker's bar series (with tick/real volume and spread).

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.BarsAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.QuoteHistory
  • Proto definition: Bars (in the QuoteHistory service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.QuoteHistory
  • Method: Bars(QuoteHistoryBarsRequest) → QuoteHistoryBarsReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): QuoteHistory.QuoteHistoryClient.Bars(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<QuoteHistoryBarsData> BarsAsync(
            string symbol,
            QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME timeframe,
            DateTime fromUtc,
            DateTime toUtc,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

QuoteHistoryBarsRequest { symbol, timeframe: QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME, fromTimeUtc, toTimeUtc }

Reply message:

QuoteHistoryBarsReply { data: QuoteHistoryBarsData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var bars = await _service.BarsAsync(
    "EURUSD", QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.QhbPeriodH1,
    DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-6), DateTime.UtcNow);
var b0 = bars.Bars.FirstOrDefault();
Console.WriteLine($"{bars.Bars.Count} bars; first O={b0?.Open} H={b0?.High} L={b0?.Low} C={b0?.Close} V={b0?.TickVolume}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
var data = await _mt4.BarsAsync(
    symbol: "EURUSD",
    timeframe: QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.QhbPeriodH1,
    fromUtc: DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-6),
    toUtc: DateTime.UtcNow,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var b in data.Bars)
    Console.WriteLine($"[{b.Time}] O:{b.Open} H:{b.High} L:{b.Low} C:{b.Close} V:{b.TickVolume}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbol string Trading symbol (e.g. "EURUSD"). timeframe QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME Bar period — see enum below. fromUtc DateTime Range start (UTC). toUtc DateTime Range end (UTC). deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call. cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — QuoteHistoryBarsData
docs.text: Field Type Description Symbol string Echoed symbol. Timeframe QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME Echoed timeframe. Bars RepeatedField<QuoteHistoryBar> The bar series. NextPageToken string Paging token for large ranges.

docs.title: QuoteHistoryBar (each bar)
docs.text: Field Type Description Time long Bar open time (server, epoch s). TimeUtc long Bar open time (UTC, epoch s). Open double Open price. High double High price. Low double Low price. Close double Close price. TickVolume long Tick volume. Spread int Spread (points) at bar. RealVolume long Real volume (if provided).

docs.title: QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME — parameter timeframe
docs.text:
Values are the bar length in minutes:

  • QhbPeriodM1 = 1 — 1-minute bars
  • QhbPeriodM5 = 5 — 5-minute bars
  • QhbPeriodM15 = 15 — 15-minute bars
  • QhbPeriodM30 = 30 — 30-minute bars
  • QhbPeriodH1 = 60 — 1-hour bars
  • QhbPeriodH4 = 240 — 4-hour bars
  • QhbPeriodD1 = 1440 — daily bars
  • QhbPeriodW1 = 10080 — weekly bars
  • QhbPeriodMn1 = 43200 — monthly bars
  • QhbPeriodUnspecified = 0 — unspecified (do not use)

Note: BarsAsync uses QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME (the Qhb* members). QuoteHistoryAsync uses the different ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME (Qh* members) — don't mix them.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text: Load candlestick data for charting, indicators and backtests — with volume/spread per bar.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• UTC in, UTC out. Pass UTC from/to; TimeUtc is the canonical timestamp for storage.
  • Paging. Wide ranges may return NextPageToken; page through instead of one huge call.
  • Enum family. Bars = QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME; QuoteHistory = ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Wrong enum. Passing a Qh* value where a Qhb* is expected won't compile — keep the two timeframe enums straight.
  • Gaps. Expect weekend/holiday gaps and variable session lengths.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Majors return a non-empty, time-ordered series; Low <= Open/Close <= High.
  • Edge cases. Narrow out-of-hours windows may return few or no bars — handle gracefully.

docs.title: Market Info — Overview
docs.text: This section contains market data and instrument metadata methods for MT4. Use it to discover symbols, read quotes, fetch historical candles, and get contract/tick parameters.

docs.title: 📂 Files in this folder
docs.text:
• AllSymbols.md Full catalogue of all instruments available in the terminal (names + indices).

  • Quote.md Latest bid/ask snapshot for a single symbol.

  • QuotesMany.md Snapshot quotes for multiple symbols at once; handy before subscribing to ticks.

  • RealTimeQuotes.md Subscribe to live ticks for a symbol.

  • QuoteHistory.md Historical OHLC data (candles) for a symbol over a timeframe.

  • SymbolInfo.md Lightweight info (digits/float-spread flag/bid) for a symbol.

  • SymbolParams.md Extended parameters: digits, volume rules, currencies, trade & execution modes.

  • TickValues.md TickValue / TickSize / ContractSize for one or more symbols (P/L & sizing math).

  • Bars.md OHLC bars (with volume/spread) for a symbol/timeframe over a UTC range.

  • SymbolSelect.md Add/remove a symbol in Market Watch before quoting/trading it.

  • ServerTimezone.md Broker server timezone / UTC offset for converting timestamps.

docs.title: 1) Build a watchlist and show live prices
docs.text:
// Discover & pick symbols
var all = await _service.SymbolsAsync();

// Get initial snapshot for the shortlist
var many = await _service.QuoteManyAsync(new[] { "EURUSD", "GBPUSD" });

// (optional) Subscribe to ticks (see Streaming section or RealTimeQuotes)
using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
await foreach (var tick in _service.OnSymbolTickAsync(new[] { "EURUSD" }, cts.Token)) { /* ... */ break; }

docs.title: 2) Validate trading inputs and display instrument info
docs.text:
// Fetch parameters for validation and formatting
var p = await _service.SymbolParamsManyAsync("EURUSD");

// Compute monetary values for risk & P/L
var tv = await _service.TickValueWithSizeAsync(new[] { "EURUSD" });

docs.title: 3) Chart a symbol
docs.text:
// Pull historical candles and render/print
var hist = await _service.QuoteHistoryAsync(
    "EURUSD", ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.QhPeriodH1,
    DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1), DateTime.UtcNow);

docs.title: ✅ Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Key by name, not index. SymbolIndex can change across sessions; persist SymbolName.
  2. Format by Digits. Use Digits from SymbolParams for UI; keep raw doubles for math.
  3. Batch when possible. Prefer QuotesMany and TickValues to reduce round‑trips.
  4. Time is UTC. Quotes and candles carry UTC timestamps—convert only at presentation.
  5. Broker suffixes are real. Treat EURUSD.m / XAUUSD-RAW as distinct symbols.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
The Market Info block helps you:

  • Discover and organize instruments.
  • Read current and historical market data.
  • Validate and format symbol‑specific values (digits, steps, currencies).
  • Compute monetary effects (tick value/size, contract size) for risk & P/L.

👉 Use this page as a map. Jump into each .md file for full method details, parameters, and pitfalls.

docs.title: Getting a Quote for Symbol
docs.text:
Request: fetch the latest quote for a given symbol Returns current bid/ask prices and server time for a specified instrument.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.QuoteAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: Quote (in the MarketInfo service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: Quote(QuoteRequest) → QuoteReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): MarketInfo.MarketInfoClient.Quote(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<QuoteData> QuoteAsync(
            string symbol,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

QuoteRequest { symbol: string }

Reply message:

QuoteReply { data: QuoteData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var q = await _service.QuoteAsync("EURUSD");
Console.WriteLine($"{q.Symbol}: Bid={q.Bid}, Ask={q.Ask}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)); // keep short; bump if your terminal is slow
var quote = await _mt4.QuoteAsync(
    symbol: "EURUSD",
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

Console.WriteLine($"Quote for EURUSD: Bid={quote.Bid}, Ask={quote.Ask}, Time={quote.DateTime.ToDateTime():yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
• symbol (string) — required. Symbol to get the quote for (e.g., "EURUSD").
  • deadline (DateTime?, optional) — optional UTC deadline for timeout.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken, optional) — optional cancellation token.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns a QuoteData object with the following fields (from proto):

Field Type Description Bid double Current bid price Ask double Current ask price DateTime Google.Protobuf.WellKnownTypes.Timestamp Server timestamp for this quote (UTC)

Note: The proto does not include spread. If you need it, compute on the client (e.g., spread = Ask - Bid).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Retrieve a live snapshot of market pricing for a specific symbol. Typical uses:

  • Building order entry or pricing dashboards
  • Quoting prices in trading UIs
  • Lightweight spread/latency checks (derive spread client-side)

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Symbol spelling. Use the exact symbol returned by SymbolsAsync() (brokers may add suffixes like EURUSD.r).
  • Timeouts. If you don't pass a deadline, the library applies its default per-RPC timeout (8s). For UI snappiness, a short 3–5s cancellation token is fine.
  • Time zone. DateTime is a server-side UTC timestamp. Convert via .ToDateTime() for display.

docs.title: Getting Historical Quote Data
docs.text:
Request: retrieve historical OHLC (candlestick) data for a given symbol Returns a list of time-based bars with open, high, low, close prices over a defined time range and timeframe.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.QuoteHistoryAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: QuoteHistory (in the MarketInfo service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: QuoteHistory(QuoteHistoryRequest) → QuoteHistoryReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): MarketInfo.MarketInfoClient.QuoteHistory(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<QuoteHistoryData> QuoteHistoryAsync(
            string symbol,
            ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME timeframe,
            DateTime from,
            DateTime to,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

QuoteHistoryRequest { symbol: string, timeframe: ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME, from, to }

Reply message:

QuoteHistoryReply { data: QuoteHistoryData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var hist = await _service.QuoteHistoryAsync(
    "EURUSD", ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.QhPeriodH1,
    DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-6), DateTime.UtcNow);
Console.WriteLine($"{hist.HistoricalQuotes.Count} bar(s)");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

var from = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-5);
var to = DateTime.UtcNow;
var timeframe = ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME.QhPeriodH1;

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); // widen if terminal is slow
var history = await _mt4.QuoteHistoryAsync(
    symbol: "EURUSD",
    timeframe: timeframe,
    from: from,
    to: to,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var candle in history.HistoricalQuotes)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"[{candle.Time}] O: {candle.Open} H: {candle.High} L: {candle.Low} C: {candle.Close}");
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
• symbol (string) — required. Trading symbol to request history for (e.g., "EURUSD").
  • timeframe (ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME) — required. Bar timeframe:

docs.title: ENUM: ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME
docs.text:
Value Description QhPeriodM1 1-minute bars QhPeriodM5 5-minute bars QhPeriodM15 15-minute bars QhPeriodM30 30-minute bars QhPeriodH1 1-hour bars QhPeriodH4 4-hour bars QhPeriodD1 Daily bars QhPeriodW1 Weekly bars QhPeriodMN1 Monthly bars
  • from (DateTime) — required. Start of the historical range (UTC).
  • to (DateTime) — required. End of the historical range (UTC).
  • deadline (DateTime?, optional) — optional UTC deadline for timeout.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken, optional) — token to cancel the request.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns a QuoteHistoryData object containing:

Field Type Description HistoricalQuotes RepeatedField<HistoryQuote> Sequence of historical OHLC bars

Each HistoryQuote includes:

Field Type Description Time Timestamp Time of the bar (UTC) Open double Opening price High double Highest price Low double Lowest price Close double Closing price

Note: In some proto versions Time may be a Timestamp; convert to local DateTime via .ToDateTime() for display.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Load candlestick-style historical price data for charting, backtesting, and technical analysis.

Typical uses:

  • Charting historical candles
  • Backtesting strategies
  • Detecting technical patterns

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• UTC range. Both from and to are interpreted as UTC on the wire. Ensure you convert local times appropriately.
  • Validation. The client validates from <= to; invalid ranges throw immediately.
  • Broker calendars. Expect gaps (weekends/holidays) and variable session times; this is normal for FX/CFD data.
  • Bar alignment. Choose from aligned to timeframe boundaries for cleaner charts (e.g., top of the hour for H1).

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Too-wide windows. Some servers limit the number of bars per request; split very long ranges into chunks.
  • Symbol suffixes. Request history for the exact symbol name returned by SymbolsAsync() (e.g., EURUSD.r).

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Non-empty bar list for liquid majors; OHLC values are consistent (Low <= Open/Close <= High).
  • Edge cases. Empty result for exotic symbols or out-of-hours windows; verify graceful handling.

docs.title: Getting Quotes for Multiple Symbols with Ticks
docs.text:
Request: fetch quotes for multiple symbols and stream real-time price ticks Combines a one-time quote snapshot (QuoteManyAsync) with a live tick stream (OnSymbolTickAsync) for each symbol.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.QuoteManyAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: QuoteMany (in the MarketInfo service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: QuoteMany(QuoteManyRequest) → QuoteManyReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): MarketInfo.MarketInfoClient.QuoteMany(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<QuoteManyData> QuoteManyAsync(
            string[] symbols,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

QuoteManyRequest { symbols: string[] }

Reply message:

QuoteManyReply { data: QuoteManyData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
// One snapshot for all symbols; you format the result.
var many = await _service.QuoteManyAsync(new[] { "EURUSD", "GBPUSD", "USDJPY" });
foreach (var x in many.Quotes)
    Console.WriteLine($"{x.Symbol}: {x.Bid}/{x.Ask}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

var symbols = new[] { "EURUSD", "GBPUSD" };

// 1) Optional: initial snapshot for all symbols
using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); // tighten/loosen as you need
var snapshot = await _mt4.QuoteManyAsync(
    symbols: symbols,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

// 2) Live first tick per symbol (soft timeout per symbol)
foreach (var symbol in symbols)
{
    using var perSymbolCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cts.Token);
    perSymbolCts.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

    try
    {
        await foreach (var tick in _mt4.OnSymbolTickAsync(new[] { symbol }, perSymbolCts.Token))
        {
            var q = tick.SymbolTick;
            if (q == null) continue;

            var time = q.Time?.ToDateTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") ?? "n/a";
            Console.WriteLine($"Tick: {q.Symbol} {q.Bid}/{q.Ask} @ {time}");
            perSymbolCts.Cancel(); // stop after the first tick
            break;
        }
    }
    catch (OperationCanceledException)
    {
        // expected if no tick within timeout
        Console.WriteLine($"⏹️ No ticks for {symbol} within 5s — skipping.");
    }
}

docs.title: For QuoteManyAsync
docs.text:
• symbols (IEnumerable<string>) — required. Array/list of trading symbols (e.g., {"EURUSD","USDJPY"}).
  • deadline (DateTime?, optional) — optional UTC deadline for timeout.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken, optional) — token to cancel the request.

docs.title: For OnSymbolTickAsync
docs.text:
• symbols (IEnumerable<string>) — required. Symbols to subscribe for real-time ticks.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken, optional) — used to stop the stream.

docs.title: From QuoteManyAsync
docs.text:
Returns QuoteManyData (container of snapshot quotes for requested symbols). Individual quote entries are of type QuoteData and expose:

Field Type Description Bid double Current bid price Ask double Current ask price DateTime Google.Protobuf.WellKnownTypes.Timestamp Server timestamp for the snapshot (UTC)

docs.title: From OnSymbolTickAsync
docs.text:
Streams OnSymbolTickData where SymbolTick contains:

Field Type Description Symbol string Symbol name Bid double Current bid price Ask double Current ask price Time Google.Protobuf.WellKnownTypes.Timestamp Server timestamp of the tick (UTC)

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Get both a quick snapshot (initial prices for multiple symbols) and live updates via ticks. Typical uses:

  • Trading dashboards and watchlists
  • Real-time price monitors and alerts
  • Preloading prices before starting live streams

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Endless stream. OnSymbolTickAsync is an open stream. Always manage cancellation (as in the example) to stop cleanly.
  • Per-symbol timeout. In the wrapper we use a small per-symbol timeout to avoid hanging when a symbol is inactive.
  • Exact names. Use the exact symbol strings from SymbolsAsync() — some brokers add suffixes (e.g., EURUSD.r).

docs.title: Streaming Real-Time Quotes for a Symbol
docs.text:
Request: subscribe to real-time bid/ask price updates for a given symbol Opens a streaming channel to receive tick-by-tick quotes as the market changes.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.OnSymbolTickAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnSymbolTick (in the SubscriptionService service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnSymbolTick(OnSymbolTickRequest) → stream OnSymbolTickReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): SubscriptionService.SubscriptionServiceClient.OnSymbolTick(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async IAsyncEnumerable<OnSymbolTickData> OnSymbolTickAsync(
            IEnumerable<string> symbols,
            [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

OnSymbolTickRequest { symbols: string[] }

Reply message:

OnSymbolTickReply { data: OnSymbolTickData } (server stream)

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (streaming; same shape as low-level) ---
using (var scts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
await foreach (var tick in _service.OnSymbolTickAsync(new[] { "EURUSD" }, scts.Token))
{
    var t = tick.SymbolTick; if (t == null) continue;
    Console.WriteLine($"{t.Symbol} {t.Bid}/{t.Ask}");
    break; // demo: stop after first tick
}

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
await foreach (var tick in _mt4.OnSymbolTickAsync(new[] { "EURUSD" }, cts.Token))
{
    var q = tick.SymbolTick; if (q == null) continue;
    var time = q.Time?.ToDateTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") ?? "n/a";
    Console.WriteLine($"Tick: {q.Symbol} {q.Bid}/{q.Ask} @ {time}");
    cts.Cancel(); // demo: stop after first tick
    break;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: The service method and the low-level call share the same signature — the service simply forwards to the account. Bound the stream yourself with a CancellationToken / timeout (the demo stops after the first tick).

docs.title: For OnSymbolTickAsync
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbols IEnumerable<string> Required. One or more symbols to subscribe. cancellationToken CancellationToken (optional) Stream control (stop/cancel).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
OnSymbolTickAsync returns a stream: IAsyncEnumerable<OnSymbolTickData>.

OnSymbolTickData contains:

Field Type Description SymbolTick QuoteData Real-time data object for tick.

QuoteData fields:

Field Type Description Symbol string Symbol name. Bid double Current bid price. Ask double Current ask price. Time Google.Protobuf.WellKnownTypes.Timestamp Server timestamp of the tick (UTC).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Receive live market data for a symbol in real time — suitable for:

  • Streaming UI quote panels
  • Price-driven alerts
  • Feeding pricing logic in automated systems

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Endless stream. This is a continuous stream; always manage cancellation (see example).
  • Normal completion signals. A RpcException with Status=Cancelled (when you cancel via token) is expected; the client treats it as normal completion. Certain server finalization codes (e.g., ON_SUBSCRIPTION_EA_DEINITIALIZATION_START_WATCHING_MULTI_CHARTS_COUNT_ZERO) are also handled as clean stream end.
  • Inactive symbols. If a symbol is inactive, you may not receive ticks within the timeout; design UI to handle this gracefully.
  • Exact naming. Use symbol names exactly as returned by SymbolsAsync() (brokers may use suffixes like EURUSD.r).

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Forgetting cancellation. Without a token or timeout, streams keep running indefinitely.
  • Mixed subscriptions. Subscribing a large set of symbols without per-symbol timeouts may block your flow if some are inactive.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. First tick arrives within a few seconds during active market hours.
  • Edge cases. In after-hours or on illiquid symbols, ensure your timeout/cancellation path logs and exits cleanly.
  • Failure path. Simulate a reconnect (temporary network issue): the client should restart the stream with backoff or end gracefully if you cancel.

docs.title: Getting the Server Timezone
docs.text:
Request: the broker server's timezone/UTC offset (ServerTimezoneData) via ServerTimezone. Use it to convert server-local times to/from UTC and to label timestamps correctly.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.ServerTimezoneAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone
  • Proto definition: ServerTimezone (in the ServerTimezone service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone
  • Method: ServerTimezone(ServerTimezoneRequest) → ServerTimezoneReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): ServerTimezone.ServerTimezoneClient.ServerTimezone(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<ServerTimezoneData> ServerTimezoneAsync(
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

ServerTimezoneRequest {}

Reply message:

ServerTimezoneReply { data: ServerTimezoneData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var tz = await _service.ServerTimezoneAsync();
Console.WriteLine($"Server={tz.Server} utcOffset={tz.UtcOffsetSeconds}s source={tz.Source}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3));
var data = await _mt4.ServerTimezoneAsync(
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

var offset = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(data.UtcOffsetSeconds);
Console.WriteLine($"{data.Server}: UTC{(offset < TimeSpan.Zero ? "" : "+")}{offset} (source: {data.Source})");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
No required parameters.

Parameter Type Description deadline DateTime? Optional absolute UTC deadline for the call. cancellationToken CancellationToken Cooperative cancel for the call/retry loop.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — ServerTimezoneData
docs.text: Field Type Description Server string Server name (e.g. "EGlobal-Demo"). UtcOffsetSeconds int Server offset from UTC, in seconds. Source SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE How the offset was determined — see enum below. ValidatedUtc Timestamp When the offset was last validated (UTC).

docs.title: SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE — field Source
docs.text:
• Unknown = 0 — source not determined
  • Live = 1 — derived from a live server response (most reliable)
  • LastValidated = 2 — last known validated value (cached/fallback)

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Correctly align times between your app (UTC) and the broker server:

  • Convert bar/quote/order timestamps to server-local for display.
  • Validate the server clock as part of a connection health check.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Prefer *Utc fields elsewhere. Most replies already expose a *Utc timestamp; use this offset only when you must show server-local time.
  • Source matters. Live is authoritative; LastValidated is a cached fallback — refresh if precision matters.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• DST drift. Some brokers shift with daylight saving; re-read the offset periodically rather than caching forever.
  • Sign confusion. UtcOffsetSeconds is server-minus-UTC; add it to UTC to get server-local time.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Server is non-empty; Source is Live; UtcOffsetSeconds matches the broker's stated timezone.
  • Edge cases. On reconnect the first read may report LastValidated before a Live value arrives.

docs.title: Getting Basic Symbol Info
docs.text:
Request: retrieve lightweight market info for a specific symbol Extracts a subset of detailed symbol parameters — mainly price precision, floating-spread flag, and bid.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.SymbolParamsManyAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: SymbolParamsMany (in the AccountHelper service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: SymbolParamsMany(SymbolParamsManyRequest) → SymbolParamsManyReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): AccountHelper.AccountHelperClient.SymbolParamsMany(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<SymbolParamsManyData> SymbolParamsManyAsync(
            string? symbolName = null,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

SymbolParamsManyRequest { symbolName?: string }

Reply message:

SymbolParamsManyReply { data: SymbolParamsManyData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var info = await _service.SymbolParamsManyAsync("EURUSD");
var p = info.SymbolInfos.FirstOrDefault();
Console.WriteLine($"{p?.SymbolName} — Digits: {p?.Digits}, SpreadFloat: {p?.SpreadFloat}, Bid: {p?.Bid}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3));
var info = await _mt4.SymbolParamsManyAsync(
    symbolName: "EURUSD",
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var param in info.SymbolInfos)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{param.SymbolName} — Digits: {param.Digits}, SpreadFloat: {param.SpreadFloat}, Bid: {param.Bid}");
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description symbol / symbolName string (required for single-symbol usage) Trading symbol to retrieve info for (e.g., "EURUSD"). deadline DateTime? (optional) Optional UTC deadline for request timeout. cancellationToken CancellationToken (optional) Token to cancel the operation.

Passing null for symbolName requests all symbols; for this example we supply a single symbol.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns a SymbolParamsManyData object with:

Field Type Description SymbolInfos RepeatedField<SymbolParamsManyInfo> Parameters for the requested symbol(s).

Selected fields from SymbolParamsManyInfo used in this example:

Field Type Description SymbolName string Symbol name. Digits int Number of decimal places in price. SpreadFloat bool true if broker uses floating spread for symbol. Bid double Current bid price snapshot.

Need the actual spread value? Derive it from quotes (spread = Ask - Bid) via QuoteAsync/QuoteManyAsync.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text: Quickly obtain the most relevant pricing attributes of a symbol — useful for compact UIs, quote panels, or quick diagnostics, without pulling every parameter.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Exact naming. Use symbol names exactly as returned by SymbolsAsync() (brokers may add suffixes like EURUSD.r).
  • One vs many. SymbolParamsManyAsync(null, ...) returns all symbols — heavier on large instrument lists; prefer single-symbol calls for UI interactions.
  • Floating spread flag. SpreadFloat is a boolean flag (not the value). To show spread in pips/points, compute from a live quote.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Symbol not found. A non-existing symbol string yields empty SymbolInfos. Validate before using.
  • Caching. Parameters change infrequently, but Bid is a snapshot — refresh if you display it as a price.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. For a major (e.g., EURUSD), Digits is 5, SymbolName matches input, SymbolInfos non-empty.
  • Edge cases. Exotic symbols may have different Digits; SymbolInfos may be empty if the symbol is disabled.
  • Failure path. Simulate disconnect — expect a clear exception from the guard (no crash).

docs.title: Getting Symbol Parameters
docs.text:
Request: retrieve extended trading parameters for a symbol Provides detailed attributes such as precision, volume limits, currencies, and trade modes.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.SymbolParamsManyAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: SymbolParamsMany (in the AccountHelper service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: SymbolParamsMany(SymbolParamsManyRequest) → SymbolParamsManyReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): AccountHelper.AccountHelperClient.SymbolParamsMany(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<SymbolParamsManyData> SymbolParamsManyAsync(
            string? symbolName = null,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

SymbolParamsManyRequest { symbolName?: string }

Reply message:

SymbolParamsManyReply { data: SymbolParamsManyData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var result = await _service.SymbolParamsManyAsync("EURUSD");
var p = result.SymbolInfos.FirstOrDefault();
Console.WriteLine($"{p?.SymbolName} Digits={p?.Digits} Vol[{p?.VolumeMin}..{p?.VolumeMax}/{p?.VolumeStep}] TradeMode={p?.TradeMode}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); // widen if terminal is slow
var result = await _mt4.SymbolParamsManyAsync(
    symbolName: "EURUSD",
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

foreach (var param in result.SymbolInfos)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Symbol: {param.SymbolName}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  Digits: {param.Digits}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  SpreadFloat: {param.SpreadFloat}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  Bid: {param.Bid}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  VolumeMin: {param.VolumeMin}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  VolumeMax: {param.VolumeMax}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  VolumeStep: {param.VolumeStep}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  CurrencyBase: {param.CurrencyBase}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  CurrencyProfit: {param.CurrencyProfit}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  CurrencyMargin: {param.CurrencyMargin}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  TradeMode: {param.TradeMode}");
    Console.WriteLine($"  TradeExeMode: {param.TradeExeMode}");
    Console.WriteLine();
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description symbol / symbolName string (required for single-symbol usage) Symbol to request parameters for (e.g., "EURUSD"). deadline DateTime? (optional) Optional UTC deadline for request timeout. cancellationToken CancellationToken (optional) Token to cancel the operation.

Passing null for symbolName requests all symbols and returns a large list.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns SymbolParamsManyData containing detailed per-symbol settings:

Field Type Description SymbolInfos RepeatedField<SymbolParamsManyInfo> Detailed parameter set per symbol.

SymbolParamsManyInfo (selected fields):

Field Type Description SymbolName string Symbol name Digits int Number of decimal places SpreadFloat bool true if broker uses floating spread (flag) Bid double Current bid snapshot VolumeMin double Minimum lot volume VolumeMax double Maximum lot volume VolumeStep double Minimum lot increment CurrencyBase string Base currency CurrencyProfit string Profit currency CurrencyMargin string Margin currency TradeMode SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE Trade mode for symbol — see enums below. TradeExeMode SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION Execution mode for symbol — see enums below.

docs.title: SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE — field TradeMode
docs.text:
• SymbolTradeModeDisabled = 0 — trading disabled for the symbol
  • SymbolTradeModeLongonly = 1 — only long (buy) positions
  • SymbolTradeModeShortonly = 2 — only short (sell) positions
  • SymbolTradeModeCloseonly = 3 — only closing of existing positions
  • SymbolTradeModeFull = 4 — unrestricted trading

docs.title: SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION — field TradeExeMode
docs.text:
• SymbolTradeExecutionRequest = 0 — request execution
  • SymbolTradeExecutionInstant = 1 — instant execution
  • SymbolTradeExecutionMarket = 2 — market execution
  • SymbolTradeExecutionExchange = 3 — exchange execution

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Retrieve a comprehensive profile of a trading instrument for validation and UI:

  • Validate orders before placement (volumes, execution mode)
  • Display symbol-specific trading conditions
  • Power instrument configuration panels

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• One vs many. For single-symbol UIs prefer passing the symbol; null loads all and can be heavy.
  • Spread value vs flag. SpreadFloat is a boolean flag. To show numeric spread, compute Ask - Bid from QuoteAsync.
  • Stability. Most parameters are stable; cache them per session. Refresh Bid via quotes when displaying live prices.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Symbol not enabled. Disabled or unknown symbols may yield empty SymbolInfos.
  • Precision mismatch. Use Digits from here when formatting prices/SL/TP to avoid broker rejections.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. For majors, Digits=5; volumes within broker limits; enums have meaningful values.
  • Edge cases. Exotic metals/indices may have different step/contract rules.
  • Failure path. Disconnect the terminal — expect a guarded exception, no crash.

docs.title: Selecting a Symbol (Market Watch)
docs.text:
Request: add a symbol to Market Watch (or remove it) via SymbolSelect, returning whether it succeeded. You must select a symbol before some quote/trade operations will see it.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.SymbolSelectAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolSelect (in the MarketInfo service)

docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo

  • SDK wrapper (your class):

{
    public class MT4Account

SymbolSelectRequest { symbol: string, select: bool }

Reply message:

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var res = await _service.SymbolSelectAsync("EURUSD", select: true);
Console.WriteLine($"SymbolSelect(EURUSD): success={res.Success}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3));

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolSelectData
docs.text: Field Type Description Success bool true if the select/deselect was applied.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Ensure a symbol is visible in Market Watch before quoting/trading it:

  • Prepare a symbol before QuoteAsync / streaming / order placement.
  • Trim Market Watch by deselecting symbols you no longer need.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Idempotent. Selecting an already-selected symbol returns Success = true without side effects.
  • Exact naming. Use the exact symbol from SymbolsAsync() (brokers may add suffixes like EURUSD.r).
  • Sugar. MT4Sugar.EnsureSelectedAsync(symbol) wraps this call with select: true.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Unknown symbol. Selecting a non-existent symbol returns Success = false — validate against SymbolsAsync() first.
  • Deselect in use. Removing a symbol you are still streaming/trading can disrupt those operations.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. SymbolSelectAsync("EURUSD", true) → Success = true; a following QuoteAsync("EURUSD") returns prices.
  • Edge cases. A bogus symbol → Success = false, no exception.

docs.title: Getting Tick Value, Size, and Contract Size
docs.text:
Request: retrieve tick value, tick size, and contract size for multiple symbols Useful for calculating profit/loss and position sizing.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.TickValueWithSizeAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: TickValueWithSize (in the AccountHelper service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: TickValueWithSize(TickValueWithSizeRequest) → TickValueWithSizeReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): AccountHelper.AccountHelperClient.TickValueWithSize(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)

namespace mt4_term_api
{

TickValueWithSizeRequest { symbols: string[] }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
var tv = await _service.TickValueWithSizeAsync(new[] { "EURUSD", "XAUUSD" });
foreach (var info in tv.Infos)
    Console.WriteLine($"{info.SymbolName}: value={info.TradeTickValue} size={info.TradeTickSize} contract={info.TradeContractSize}");

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

var result = await _mt4.TickValueWithSizeAsync(
    symbolNames: new[] { "EURUSD", "XAUUSD" },

foreach (var info in result.Infos)
{

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbols / symbolNames IEnumerable<string> (required) One or more trading symbols (e.g., "EURUSD", "XAUUSD"). deadline DateTime? (optional) Optional UTC deadline for request timeout. cancellationToken CancellationToken (optional) Token to cancel the operation.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns TickValueWithSizeData containing:

Field Type Description Infos RepeatedField<SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo> Tick-related info per symbol.

SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo fields:

Field Type Description SymbolName string Trading symbol name. TradeTickValue double Monetary value of one tick in the account currency. TradeTickSize double Minimal price increment (tick size). TradeContractSize double Units per 1.0 lot (broker-defined; e.g., 100000 for many FX pairs).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Provide core parameters for:

  • Profit/loss estimation
  • Pip value conversions
  • Position sizing formulas

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Pip vs tick. A pip is not always equal to one tick. Derive pip value as: pipValue = TradeTickValue * (pipSize / TradeTickSize) where pipSize depends on the instrument (e.g., 0.0001 for 5-digit FX pairs, 0.01 for JPY pairs).
  • Account currency. TradeTickValue is already in the account currency; no extra conversion needed unless you aggregate across accounts.
  • Contract size. Metals/indices/CFDs may use different contract sizes than FX. Always read TradeContractSize from the API instead of hardcoding.
  • Caching. These parameters are fairly stable; cache per session and refresh when switching accounts or symbol groups.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Wrong pip math. Using Ask-Bid directly as “pips” without normalizing by TradeTickSize leads to wrong P/L.
  • Assuming FX-only sizes. Not all instruments use 100000 units/lot; indices/commodities vary by broker.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. For majors, TradeTickSize≈1e-5 and TradeContractSize≈100000.
  • Edge cases. JPY pairs have TradeTickSize≈0.001; metals/indices return broker-specific contract sizes.
  • Failure path. Invalid/disabled symbol should not crash; handle empty or missing entries gracefully.

docs.title: Closing an Order By Opposite
docs.text:
Request: close one open order using another opposite-position order Sends a request to match and close two opposite-direction orders by ticket.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.OrderCloseByAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderCloseBy (in the TradingHelper service)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderCloseBy(OrderCloseByRequest) → OrderCloseByReply
  • Low‑level client (generated): TradingHelper.TradingHelperClient.OrderCloseBy(request, headers, deadline, cancellationToken)
  • SDK wrapper (your class):
namespace mt4_term_api
{
    public class MT4Account
    {
        public async Task<OrderCloseByData> OrderCloseByAsync(
            OrderCloseByRequest request,
            DateTime? deadline = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

Request message:

OrderCloseByRequest { TicketToClose: int, OppositeTicketClosingBy: int }

Reply message:

OrderCloseByReply { data: OrderCloseByData }

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
// Build the request (see below) and call: await _service.OrderCloseByAsync(request);

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.
// Both tickets must be OPEN and of OPPOSITE types (Buy vs Sell) on the SAME symbol.

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

var request = new OrderCloseByRequest
{
    TicketToClose = 123456,
    OppositeTicketClosingBy = 654321
};

var result = await _mt4.OrderCloseByAsync(
    request: request,
    deadline: null,
    cancellationToken: cts.Token);

Console.WriteLine($"Closed by opposite: Profit={result.Profit}, Price={result.ClosePrice}, Time={result.CloseTime}");

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
• request (OrderCloseByRequest) — structure with:
Field Type Description TicketToClose int Ticket ID of the primary order to close. OppositeTicketClosingBy int Ticket ID of the opposite order used to close the first one.

Optional:

  • deadline (DateTime?) — optional per-call deadline.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken) — to cancel the request.

⚠️ Both tickets must be valid open orders, on the same symbol, and with opposite directions.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text:
Returns OrderCloseByData with:

Field Type Description Profit double Profit/loss from the close-by operation. ClosePrice double Execution price of the operation. CloseTime Timestamp Timestamp of the operation.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text: Close matched hedge positions — one Buy and one Sell — via the Close By mechanism. This can reduce commission/slippage compared to closing each order separately.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Same symbol & opposite side. Close By works only when both orders are for the same instrument and have opposite directions.
  • Volumes. Brokers commonly require equal volumes for a single Close By operation. If volumes differ, the request may be rejected; use partial close(s) or multiple operations if supported by your workflow.
  • Ticket range. This API uses int tickets on the wire. If you store tickets as long, ensure they fit into Int32 before sending.
  • Hedging mode. Close By implies hedged positions. If the account/broker enforces netting, this operation may not be allowed.

docs.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Already closed/invalid ticket. Expect an API error if either ticket is not currently open.
  • Different symbols or same side. Any mismatch leads to a clear server error.
  • Symbol suffixes. EURUSD.m and EURUSD are different instruments — match exactly.

docs.title: 🧪 Testing Suggestions
docs.text:
• Happy path. Open a Buy and a Sell with the same symbol and same lot; call OrderCloseByAsync and verify Profit aligns with price difference and contract settings.
  • Edge cases. Try mismatched symbols or same-side tickets and confirm a proper ApiExceptionMT4 is thrown and handled.
  • Timeouts. Use a short cancellation window (e.g., 3–5s) and verify graceful cancellation without leaving partial states.

docs.title: Closing an Order
docs.text:
Request: close or delete an open order by its ticket Sends a request to the server to close or delete the specified order.

API Information:

  • SDK wrapper: MT4Account.OrderCloseDeleteAsync(...) (from NuGet package MetaRPC.MT4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderCloseDelete (in the TradingHelper service)

Request message:

OrderCloseDeleteRequest { OrderTicket: int }

Reply message:

OrderCloseDeleteReply { data: OrderCloseDeleteData }

docs.text:
// --- Service wrapper (typed, data-returning) ---
// Build the request (see below) and call: await _service.OrderCloseDeleteAsync(request);
// Or via sugar (by ticket): await _service.CloseByTicketAsync(123456);

// --- Low-level (direct account call) ---
// Preconditions: account is connected via ConnectByServerName/ConnectByHostPort.

Field Type Description OrderTicket int Required. Ticket number of the order to close/delete.

Optional:

  • deadline (DateTime?) — optional per-call deadline.
  • cancellationToken (CancellationToken) — to cancel the request.

The ticket must correspond to a currently open order; otherwise the server returns errors like Invalid ticket or Ticket not found.
